يتباءس (form VI)
# يَتَبَاءَسُ (yatabāʔasu) /ja.ta.baː.ʔa.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَاءَسَ (tabāʔasa)
# يَتَبَاءَسَ (yatabāʔasa) /ja.ta.baː.ʔa.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاءَسَ (tabāʔasa)
# يَتَبَاءَسْ (yatabāʔas) /ja.ta.baː.ʔas/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَبَاءَسَ (tabāʔasa)
